Title: A sales order with a committed delivery date reaches the MES with that date
Describe the case: When the sales rep confirms a sales order in the ERP with a committed delivery date, the order must reach the MES with that same date, because planning sequences the mill by delivery date. Example: 30 t of Pickled coil DD11 for Atlantic Tube Ltd. with delivery on 2026-12-15.
How do you know it worked?: The MES list of manufacturing orders shows the order for the sales order with customer Atlantic Tube Ltd., grade DD11, 30 t and due date 2026-12-15.
